method: Public native-host fixture with controlled provider responses and seven configured companion extensions. Raw credential-free logs and executable probes remain outside this repository.

runs.scope: companion composition, both load orders, selection, history, and activation in a retained conversation
cancelled wait, termination, session replacement, reload, shutdown, and interactive quit
continued mixed workflows in both load orders and true interrupted-history resume

observed: A live cell continued command, patch, validation, and local-image work across later prompts in both load orders.
Configured hooks blocked and edited child calls and redacted a result without restoring removed structured content in the model-visible wait result.
Unrelated declarations remained selected; no companion goal operation was called or modified.
Public activity rendered while a cell ran and after a genuine abrupt exit, while remaining outside model context.
Cancellation of a later wait retained unread output; explicit termination and native session lifecycle events cleared owned work.
Stored values survived an ordinary prompt and cleared after new, resume, fork, and reload.
Notifications arrived at the safe boundary without an unsolicited provider request or duplicated model content.
limits: Controlled responses verify integration behavior, not matched live-model outcomes.
The public host does not assign durable native child-call identity after the parent returns; activity uses package-owned identities.
Native image conversion reports automatic detail for the local-image result.
The configured companion set had no separate override for a replaced core tool name.
